sloka: यावत्तव कथा लोके विचरिष्यति पावनी ।तावत्स्थास्यामि मेदिन्यां तवाज्ञामनुपालयन् ।। ७.१०८.३६ ॥
transliteration: yāvattava kathā loke vicariṣyati pāvanī ।tāvatsthāsyāmi medinyāṁ tavājñāmanupālayan ।। 7.108.36 ॥

translations.english: As long as your purifying story spreads throughout the world, I shall remain on earth, obeying your command.
